title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - NearBodyWearable
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/NearBodyWearable. A wearable device located near (but not in direct contact with) the physical body of its Wearer (e.g. a smart badge on a lanyard). Subclass of WearableDevice per the SAREF4WEAR ontology; inherited properties are documented on the WearableDevice model and not repeated here. Its own defining axiom is the isLocatedNear relationship (a sub-property of WearableDevice.isLocated) to a Wearer.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'NearBodyWearable'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isLocatedNear.description: Relationship. The Wearer near whose body this wearable is located (s4wear:isLocatedNear, sub-property of isLocated). Links to a Wearer entity.
